blocks.content: This chapter covers Mizoram-specific development initiatives (including recent 2025-26 announcements) and its tourism circuit, which draws on the geography, culture and wildlife content of the preceding chapters.

items: Bana Kaih (Handholding) Scheme — the current government's flagship livelihood/entrepreneurship support initiative (Chapter 6), complemented by a Rs 20-crore Venture Capital Fund for young entrepreneurs and the Industrial and Investment Policy 2025.
Central flagship schemes (Ayushman Bharat, PM Awas Yojana, Jal Jeevan Mission, PM-KISAN) have been extended to Mizoram alongside these state-specific initiatives.

The state government has announced a policy of administrative decentralisation aimed at correcting long-standing regional developmental disparities, alongside an intensified 'Year of Discipline' (2026-27) campaign against drugs and illegal liquor.
Mizoram University Health Care Scheme (MUHCS) is the state's flagship health-insurance/healthcare-financing scheme, supplementing central health schemes.

cells: State capital; Solomon's Temple (a large, privately built replica temple), Mizoram State Museum

blocks.content: ★ EXAM POINT: Solomon's Temple, Aizawl — a large, privately constructed replica temple — is a distinctive, frequently mentioned modern landmark of the state capital.

items: Bana Kaih (Handholding) Scheme, a Venture Capital Fund, and the Industrial and Investment Policy 2025 are current flagship economic initiatives.
Aizawl (Solomon's Temple), Phawngpui, Champhai, Vantawng Falls, and Reiek are the main tourism destinations.
